description: This file contains the implementation of the AWCContainer class, which manages container lifecycle operations such as start, stop, and state change notifications within the WPEFramework's process containerization system. It interacts with external components like AWCClient and AWCContainerAdministrator, and includes methods for waiting until the container is ready, starting, stopping, and handling state change notifications.

classes.name: AWCContainer
classes.description: A class that manages the lifecycle and state of a container, including starting, stopping, and handling state change notifications.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container if it is in the started state; otherwise, returns 0.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running based on internal state variables.

methods.name: WaitUntilAWCReady
methods.description: Polls the AWC service until it reports readiness or a timeout occurs.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters, waiting for confirmation of startup.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, waiting for confirmation of shutdown or timeout.

methods.name: notifyStateChange
methods.description: Handles notifications about state changes from the AWC service, updating internal state accordingly.
